decks.notes: The deck is focused on assembling a combo win condition using Doomsday to set up a winning pile of cards, with the ability to protect the combo with counter spells and disruption. It aims to quickly and efficiently dig through the deck using cantrips and tutors, while generating mana with rituals and fast mana artifacts. The win condition is typically to use Doomsday to set up a Thassa's Oracle win, and the deck includes various ways to protect this win condition against disruption from the opponent.

The deck focuses on card advantage and resource denial, utilizing powerful control elements like counterspells, removal, and card draw. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while accruing value through cards like Hullbreacher and Dack Fayden. With multiple powerful combo pieces like Time Vault and Bolas's Citadel, the deck can quickly pivot from defense to offense. Its efficient mana base and access to powerful spells like Ancestral Recall and Demonic Tutor ensure that it can maintain control of the game and dominate the late game.

This deck aims to quickly assemble a winning combination using the card Doomsday. By utilizing powerful draw spells, tutors, and counterspells, the player can set up their library in a specific order that allows them to win the game on the same turn that Doomsday is cast. The deck's strategy focuses on efficiently stacking the deck to guarantee a win condition, usually involving casting Thassa's Oracle and winning the game immediately. The deck is designed to be quick and resilient, able to disrupt opponent's strategies while executing its own game plan effectively.

This deck aims to assemble the Coveted Jewel combo by using various fast mana and card draw spells to generate enough mana to cast Coveted Jewel as quickly as possible. The deck includes multiple artifact tutors such as Tinker and Mystic Forge to find the pieces needed to win the game, while also utilizing powerful disruptive spells like Force of Will to protect the combo. The deck's win condition is to activate Coveted Jewel multiple times in a turn to generate a massive advantage over the opponent.

The primary objective of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deploy creatures such as Bloodghast, Vengevine, and Hollow One while utilizing Bazaar of Baghdad to fill the graveyard and enable powerful synergies. The deck also features disruption elements like Force of Vigor and Collector Ouphe to disrupt opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck aims to generate mana advantage through cards like Gaea's Cradle and accelerate its game plan with cards like Once Upon a Time. Overall, this deck seeks to overwhelm opponents with fast, explosive plays and graveyard synergies.

The main concept of this Dredge Combo deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with cards like Stinkweed Imp, Golgari Grave-Troll, and Shambling Shell, allowing the player to constantly bring back creatures like Narcomoeba, Ichorid, and Prized Amalgam from the graveyard for continuous pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Hollow One and Creeping Chill for additional damage and Noxious Revival for graveyard manipulation. With the ability to disrupt the opponent with cards like Force of Will and Mindbreak Trap, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a relentless combo strategy.

The deck focuses on using Underworld Breach to combo off and create a powerful win condition. It includes various tutors, card draw spells, and counter spells to help find and protect the combo pieces. The deck also utilizes artifacts like Moxen, Mana Crypt, and Time Vault to generate mana and accelerate its game plan. The inclusion of Bolas's Citadel and Brain Freeze provides alternate win conditions. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a game-winning play.

This deck focuses on deploying hatebears like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Chancellor of the Annex to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Archon of Emeria and Solitude. The deck also utilizes disruptive lands like Karakas and Wasteland to further disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Anointed Peacekeeper and Seasoned Dungeoneer to control the board and draw cards respectively. The key strategy is to slow down the opponent's plays while maintaining a strong board presence to secure victory.

This Doomsday combo deck is designed to quickly and efficiently assemble and cast the powerful spell Doomsday, allowing the player to manipulate their deck and win the game with Thassa's Oracle. By using various powerful card draw and tutor effects, along with protection spells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm, this deck aims to set up its win condition as fast as possible while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of additional draw and cantrip spells help ensure consistency in finding key combo pieces and maximizing the chances of a successful combo.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle to win the game quickly. It utilizes cards like Demonic Consultation, Vampiric Tutor, and Demonic Tutor to search for combo pieces, while also running card draw spells like Ponder, Preordain, and Gitaxian Probe to help dig through the deck. The deck also includes disruption like Force of Will, Flusterstorm, and Duress to protect the combo. By efficiently cycling through the library and resolving Doomsday, the deck aims to win the game in a single turn.

The deck revolves around using various card draw and search effects to find and create a game-winning situation using the combination of Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle. Key cards like Dark Ritual, Demonic Tutor, and Force of Will help support the combo and protect it from disruption. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo pieces and win the game in a single turn, relying on its ability to manipulate the library and draw cards efficiently to ensure success.

This Aggro-MUD Vintage deck focuses on resource denial and disrupting the opponent's game plan through cards like Wasteland, Sphere of Resistance, and Crucible of Worlds. It also utilizes powerful artifacts like Golos, Tireless Pilgrim, Time Vault, and Inventors' Fair to generate mana and search for key pieces. The deck aims to control the board with Karn, the Great Creator and Nettlecyst while also presenting threats like Lodestone Golem and Phyrexian Revoker. With a strong artifact package and disruptive elements, this deck aims to overwhelm and outpace the opponent in a quick and efficient manner.

This deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Basking Rootwalla, Vengevine, and Hollow One, supported by powerful lands like Gaea's Cradle and Bazaar of Baghdad. The deck utilizes cards like Once Upon a Time and Serum Powder to ensure consistent early plays, while disruptive creatures like Collector Ouphe and Hexdrinker help disrupt the opponent's strategy. With an emphasis on explosive starts and efficient creatures, this deck looks to win the game before the opponent can establish their own game plan.

This Vintage Dredge Combo deck focuses on quickly filling your graveyard with cards like Golgari Grave-Troll and Stinkweed Imp, triggering abilities like Narcomoeba and Prized Amalgam to swarm the board. Using Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder to dig through your deck, you can quickly bring out powerful creatures and disrupt your opponent with cards like Force of Will and Force of Negation. With tools like Creeping Chill and Grief for additional disruption and damage, this deck aims to overwhelm your opponent before they have a chance to react.

The deck focuses on deploying disruptive early creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Chancellor of the Annex to slow down the opponent while using hate cards like Archon of Emeria to further disrupt their game plan. It also includes powerful white removal spells like Solitude to deal with threats. The deck aims to apply pressure quickly with its aggressive creatures while also disrupting the opponent's strategy, creating a challenging and controlling game plan for the opponent.

The deck is focused on using artifacts and powerful mana acceleration to set up a combo involving Paradoxical Outcome, Coveted Jewel, and Urza's Saga. By generating a large amount of mana with cards like Tolarian Academy and Mishra's Workshop, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces to draw cards, generate mana, and ultimately win the game through a combination of card advantage and mana advantage. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Trinisphere to disrupt opponents' strategies while setting up its own win conditions.
